title: bribria crenata
intro: Bribria crenata, commonly known as the 'Mountain Sage' or 'Wild Sage', is a plant species that belongs to the family Boraginaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits such as reducing inflammation, fighting off infections, and alleviating symptoms of respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Bribria crenata include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. These constituents work synergistically to provide relief from conditions like bronchitis, cough, and sore throats, while also supporting the immune system.
